plugin_desc: SNMP monitoring template for Ciena Waveserver / Waveserver Ai DWDM platforms (PEN 1271, CIENA-WS-CHASSIS-MIB). Besides standard IF-MIB 64-bit interface traffic, it collects the operational state of power supply units and cooling fan units.
name: Transmission

metrics.name: device_psu_state
metrics.description: Operational state of each Ciena Waveserver power supply unit from cwsChassisPsuStateOperationalState (ChassisOperationState). normal(1) is stored as 1, faulted(2) as 2; uninstalled(0) and any other code are dropped so an empty slot is not treated as a fault.

metrics.name: device_fan_state
metrics.description: Operational state of each Ciena Waveserver cooling fan unit from cwsChassisFanStateOperationalState (ChassisOperationState). normal(1) is stored as 1, faulted(2) as 2; uninstalled(0) and any other code are dropped.

metrics.name: interface_ifHCInOctets
metrics.description: This metric indicates the average rate of bytes received over the past 5 minutes, measured in bytes per second, from the 64-bit IF-MIB ifHCInOctets counter (ifXTable).

metrics.name: interface_ifHCOutOctets
metrics.description: This metric calculates the average rate of bytes sent over the past 5 minutes, measured in bytes per second, from the 64-bit IF-MIB ifHCOutOctets counter (ifXTable).

metrics.name: snmp_uptime
metrics.description: This metric indicates the uptime of the device since the last restart. By monitoring the uptime, network administrators can understand the stability and reliability of the Ciena Waveserver transmission device and identify potential reboot or failure issues.
